headline: US Crude Inventories Decline by 1.9 Million Barrels
summary: U.S. commercial crude oil inventories decreased by 1.9 million barrels during the week ending October 23, bringing stockpiles to 410.6 million barrels, according to EIA data.
why: The U.S. Energy Information Administration provides official weekly data on domestic energy inventories, serving as a key indicator for oil market balance.

impacts.name: WTI Crude
impacts.why: Declining inventories signal stronger demand or tighter supply, supporting crude prices.

why_moved: Inventory draws exceeding expectations reduce available supply, acting as a direct bullish catalyst for crude futures.
